ffxiii2-nx package rc7 (2026-11-07): build k234 (the PC build k234pc sources).

WHAT CHANGED SINCE rc6
1. Same fixes as rc6 (D-008 flicker: depth binding taken at bind time, tiling check by origin), confirmed by you on
   the PC (battle fixed, Serah drawn in New Bodhum).
2. Diagnostics for the opening cutscene (all off in this package, the picture is unchanged): draw call chains per
   frame, the game's pass-1 list counts, renderer draw exits.

STILL OPEN
- The opening cutscene: Lightning's face is drawn every other frame (0:08-0:21). The game code itself leaves her out
  on those frames, the same on both renderers; you confirmed the Xbox 360 is steady, so the fault is in the
  recompiled game code. Being worked on next.
- Rare crash when the game is started right after it was closed (D-006).
- Not yet tested on the Switch: whether the band (D-003) is gone there too.

INSTALL: copy COPY_TO_SD_switch_ffxiii2-nx\ to sdmc:/switch/ffxiii2-nx/ (your saves in renut/ are not touched).
ROLL BACK: the rc6 package (Works\builds\2026-11-06_2013_ffxiii2_rc6) is unchanged.
Credits: reNut's renderer (its author permits reuse), katamari-nx, renut-nx, sa2-nx, NetherSX2_nx, battd_nx,
bejeweled3-nx / zuma ports. GPL-3.0 where the sources are.
